title: Tilecast native bridge, version 1
description: Messages between Tilecast Studio and a native host application. Every value is JSON. A receiver ignores unknown payload properties; removing or changing a property requires a new protocol version.

versionProbe.description: Read first. A receiver refuses any version it does not implement before it inspects the rest of the message.

requestId.description: Optional correlation identifier. Replies echo it.

destinationId.description: An opaque navigation destination identifier. Only Studio interprets it.

title.description: Display text, already localized by Studio.

iconToken.description: Advisory semantic icon. A host shows its generic icon for a token it does not recognize. See icon-tokens.json.

mobilePlacement.description: Where a compact-width host prefers the destination. Omitted means more.

title.description: Omitted for a group that has no heading.

navigationCatalogPayload.description: A complete snapshot that replaces the previous catalog. Groups and items are in display order. Destination identifiers are unique across the catalog, and the catalog holds at most 128 destinations. No groups means native navigation is not available now.

activeDestinationId.description: The destination Studio resolved for the current location, or null when the location belongs to no destination. Authoritative for native selection.

path.description: The location path, without a query string. Diagnostics only. A host never derives selection from it.

capabilities.description: Capabilities Studio supports in this document. A capability that is absent or not true is unavailable, so a host never sends a message that needs it.

authLifecycle.description: Studio handles auth/sign-out-request and reports auth/signed-out.

nativePresentations.description: Studio has the /__native/modal presentation routes, handles the presentation messages, and handles navigation/open-path.

nativeAlerts.description: Studio handles alert/action, so a host may show its alert for an alert/present.

nativeActionMenus.description: Studio handles action-menu/action and the action-menu lifecycle, so a host may arm long-press menus or accept anchored trigger registrations.

nativeMediaIntake.description: Studio handles system/media-intake-completed. A host sends it only to a Studio that reported this.

deepLinks.description: Studio handles navigation/open-path that a host sends for a deep link, and refuses the reserved authentication paths.

navigationChromePayload.description: The chrome of the page Studio shows in the main page. When back is present the page is a drill-in, and the host shows a native navigation bar with a back button and the title. Without back the host shows no bar. The host learns no path: it sends navigation/back, and Studio's router decides where that goes.

label.description: The name of the page back leads to, already localized.

configGetResult.description: The payload of a successful config/get reply.

context.description: The kind of page this bridge belongs to. Omitted means main, as hosts before presentations reply.

capabilities.description: Capabilities the host offers. A capability that is absent or not true is unavailable.

authLifecycle.description: The host keeps a native credential whose lifecycle follows Studio's sign-out. Studio reports auth/signed-out only to a host that offers it.

nativePresentations.description: The host can present /__native/modal routes in a native sheet. On the main page it accepts presentation/open; on the presentation page it sends presentation/show.

nativeAlerts.description: The host can show a native alert for alert/present, on the main page and on the presentation page.

nativeActionMenus.description: The host can show generic native action menus and long-press menus on the main page and presentation page.

nativeActionMenuAnchors.description: The host can register normalized Studio trigger rectangles and overlay real anchored native Menu controls for action-menu/register-trigger.

systemShare.description: The host presents the system share sheet for system/share. Both contexts.

systemHaptics.description: The host performs standard system feedback for system/haptic. Both contexts.

systemQrScanner.description: The host can scan one QR code with the system camera for system/scan-qr, and reports the bounded text with system/qr-scan-result. Both contexts.

nativeMediaIntake.description: The host can choose media with system pickers and upload it with its own credential. Main page only. system/media-intake-status reports whether it can start now.

deepLinks.description: The host can deliver a validated Studio path with navigation/open-path when the app opens from a deep link. Main page only. Sent only to a Studio that reported deepLinks.

bridgeContext.description: The kind of page a bridge endpoint belongs to. main is the one Studio page with native navigation and the auth lifecycle. presentation is the page that renders native presentation content.

presentationId.description: An opaque identifier Studio creates for one presentation. It is not a request id: it separates one presentation from the next, so a late message about an old presentation cannot change a newer one.

presentationPath.description: A same-origin path inside the reserved presentation route tree, /__native/modal. A host knows only this root; Studio owns every child route. A decoder also refuses dot segments, which could leave the tree.

studioPath.description: An ordinary same-origin Studio path, with an optional query and fragment. The host treats it as opaque after validation. A decoder also refuses dot segments and the reserved /__native tree.

presentationSize.description: How much room the presentation needs. compact starts at half height and can grow; full takes the whole sheet. A host shows any other value as full.

actionId.description: An opaque toolbar action identifier. Only the presentation's Studio page interprets it. The reserved id back reports the leading back button.

label.description: Localized. The host shows the icon and uses the label for accessibility.

presentationHeader.description: A complete snapshot of the native header. It replaces the previous header; omitted actions and menu mean none. Action and menu ids are unique across the header.

navigation.description: The leading control. close dismisses the presentation. back reports the action id back. A host shows any other value as close.

navigationLabel.description: Localized accessibility label of the leading control.

menuLabel.description: Localized accessibility label of the overflow menu.

presentationOpenPayload.description: The main Studio page asks the host to present a route. title and subtitle are already localized. dismissible defaults to true.

presentationUpdatePayload.description: The presentation page changes its native chrome. Each property that is present replaces the current value.

alertId.description: An opaque identifier Studio creates for one alert. A host reports the choice for that alert only, and Studio ignores a choice for an alert it does not know.

alertButton.description: One button of a native alert. label is already localized. role is advisory: cancel and destructive get the platform's styling, and any other value is default.

alertPresentPayload.description: Studio asks the host to show an alert with one to three buttons. The host answers ok when it shows the alert, and unavailable when it cannot, for example because another alert is showing. Studio then shows its own dialog.

menuId.description: An opaque identifier Studio creates for one action menu. A host reports the choice for that menu only, and Studio ignores a choice for a menu it does not know.

actionMenuRole.description: Advisory styling. destructive gets the platform's destructive styling, and any other value is default, so Studio can name a new role without a host release.

actionMenuItem.description: One action of a native menu. label is already localized. icon is advisory: a host shows no icon for a token it does not recognize. disabled defaults to false.

actionMenuGroup.description: One section of a menu. A host separates groups visually. Studio sends no empty group.

actionMenuDescriptor.description: A complete generic menu. label names the menu for accessibility, already localized. Action ids are unique across the menu, and the menu holds at most 24 items. Only Studio knows what an action does.

actionMenuTriggerRect.description: The visible part of a Studio menu trigger normalized to the current WebView viewport.

actionMenuTriggerPayload.description: A complete generic menu plus the normalized visible rectangle of its Studio trigger.

menuIdPayload.description: Withdraws the menu Studio named, for example when its component went away. A host ignores a menu that is not armed or showing.

actionMenuActionPayload.description: The user chose an action. actionId is one of the ids Studio sent for this menu.

actionMenuDismissedPayload.description: The user dismissed a menu the host was showing without choosing an action.

alertActionPayload.description: The user chose a button. actionId is one of the ids Studio sent.

navigationOpenPathPayload.description: The host relays a path from a presentation to the main Studio page, which navigates with its router.

frontendToNative.description: Studio to the native host. Each message receives a reply.

allOf.description: Studio completed its own sign-out. The payload carries no credential or account data.
Main page only. A presentation page that sends it gets forbidden.
Presentation page only. Its Studio started, is signed in, and receives presentation/show.
Presentation page only. A host ignores an update for a presentation that is not active.
Presentation page only. Asks the host to dismiss the presentation.
Main page only. Describes the native navigation bar for the current page. A host that does not know this message answers unknown_type, and Studio keeps its own breadcrumbs.
Either page. Shows a native alert, so a confirmation matches the platform. The page that sent it receives alert/action.
Either page. Withdraws an alert the page presented, for example when the dialog's owner went away. A host ignores an alert that is not showing.

Either page. Shows a native menu at once, for example for a three-dot button. The host answers ok when it shows the menu, and unavailable when it cannot, for example because another menu is showing. Studio then shows its own web menu. The page that sent it receives action-menu/action or action-menu/dismissed.

Either page. Arms a native context menu for a long press, replacing any menu this page armed. The host answers ok when it armed the menu. The page that sent it receives action-menu/action when the user chooses.
Either page. Withdraws a menu the page presented or armed, for example when the menu's owner went away. A host ignores a menu that is not armed or showing.
Either page. Registers or updates a visible Studio action trigger so the host can place a real native Menu over that exact rectangle.
Either page. Removes a previously registered native Menu trigger.
Presentation page only. The host dismisses the presentation, then relays the path to the main page with navigation/open-path.
Either context. The host maps the semantic feedback onto standard system feedback and never a custom pattern.
Either context. The host presents the system share sheet, or replies unavailable.
Main page only. The reply payload is systemMediaIntakeStatusReplyPayload.
Main page only. A presentation page that sends it gets forbidden. Sent only when the host offered nativeMediaIntake and reported it available.

Either context. Studio asks the host to scan one QR code. The host replies ok when it begins presenting the scanner, or unavailable when it cannot: unsupported hardware, another scan active, or no camera. The result arrives later as system/qr-scan-result.
Main page only. Studio navigates with its router, so unsaved-change blockers apply.
Presentation page only. Studio shows this route for this presentation without a page load.
Presentation page only. The user chose a header action.
Presentation page only. The native sheet went away, however it was dismissed.
Main page only. A presentation ended, however it was dismissed. Studio refetches what a presentation may have changed. Sent only when the main page negotiated nativePresentations.

Main page only. The user tapped the native back button. Studio navigates to the previous page of its trail with React Router, so unsaved-change blockers apply. Sent only after Studio sent navigation/chrome with back.
The user chose a button of an alert this page presented.
The user chose an action of a menu this page presented or armed.
The user dismissed a menu this page presented without choosing an action.
The host asks Studio to sign out with its normal logout. Studio answers with auth/signed-out when it is done. The payload carries no credential.
Main page only. Sent to the page that asked, and only when it reported nativeMediaIntake. A page that no longer exists is not reloaded for it.

Either context. Sent to the page that asked for system/scan-qr, and only while that scan is active. A result for a stale request, or for a page whose presentation ended, is never delivered to another page.

reply.description: The native host's reply to a frontendToNative message.

hapticFeedback.description: A semantic feedback type. Studio names the meaning and the host chooses the hardware effect. Known values: selection, success, warning, error, start, stop. A host accepts a value it does not know and performs nothing, so a newer Studio never breaks an older host.

shareUrl.description: An absolute HTTP or HTTPS URL without user information. A host also refuses a URL whose query or fragment names a credential, and a URL that carries a Tilecast credential.

systemSharePayload.description: Normal, user-visible content to hand to the system share sheet. At least text or url is required. A host ignores properties it does not know.

mediaIntakeKind.description: A media kind hint for the system picker. Known values: image, video. A host ignores a kind it does not know.

available.description: Whether the host can start media intake now: it needs a native credential for this server. Studio uses its own uploader when this is not true.

systemMediaIntakePayload.description: Asks the host to choose media with system pickers and upload it. The request carries no file data, no path, and no credential. The host replies unavailable when it cannot begin, and Studio uses its own uploader.

mediaIntakeCompletedPayload.description: A small coordination result. The host uploaded the media itself. Studio refetches its own media queries.

qrScanRequestId.description: An opaque identifier Studio creates for one QR scan. It separates one scan from the next, so a late result cannot resolve a newer scan.

qrScanValue.description: The scanned QR code's text payload, bounded. No image data, camera frame, file URL, or credential crosses the bridge.

systemQrScanPayload.description: Asks the host to scan one QR code with the system camera. The host replies ok when scanning begins; the result arrives later as system/qr-scan-result.

qrScanResultPayload.description: The outcome of one QR scan. scanned carries the payload text; cancelled means the user dismissed the scanner; unavailable means scanning failed after acceptance, for example a revoked permission.
